claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) interprets Jesus as the Sun and his twelve disciples as zodiac signs, reading the cross as zodiacal symbolism.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She interprets the winter-solstice story as the Sun's symbolic death, three-day obscurity, and rebirth around December 24–25.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She clarifies that the Sun still rises during these days.

claims.assertion: Swaruu alleges the Gospels are astrotheological rather than biographical and that Josephus's scribes under Vespasian compiled and altered canonical and apocryphal texts.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: Attributed historical claims; Constantine is separately credited with official compilation.
